boiler_upgrade.info_text: Technical retrofitting of a hazardous production facility involves the introduction of new technology, automation of the hazardous production facility or its individual parts, modernization or replacement of technical devices used at the hazardous production facility, leading to changes in the production process.
boiler_upgrade.info_sub: Source: Federal Law No. 116-FZ dated 21.07.1997 "On Industrial Safety of Hazardous Production Facilities" // SZ RF. 1997. No. 30. Art. 3588. (paragraph nine of Article 1) (paragraph supplemented by Federal Law No. 22-FZ dated 04.03.2013)
boiler_upgrade.questions_intro: Currently, many enterprises face the need to replace heat-generating equipment that has exhausted its service life. In this case, a number of questions arise:
boiler_upgrade.q1: How to carry out modernization during the operation of an active enterprise without stopping its core business?
boiler_upgrade.q2: How to implement modernization at the lowest cost?
boiler_upgrade.q3: What technical solutions will achieve maximum energy efficiency, i.e., achieve the optimal ratio of energy consumption per 1 kW of generated capacity?
boiler_upgrade.q4: How to increase the capacity of the boiler room?
boiler_upgrade.q5: What set of documents will be required to complete the full scope of work?
boiler_upgrade.questions_outro: The specialists of Energy Plus LLC are ready to offer solutions to these and many other issues that arise when carrying out this type of work. Taking into account the design features of the facility and the Customer's requirements, we will optimize costs for the above activities, especially regarding the preparation of documentation required by regulatory authorities, which in terms of labor intensity is comparable to construction and installation works, and in terms of duration often exceeds them.
boiler_upgrade.step1: Energy audit, equipment selection, feasibility studies and justification for technical retrofitting/modernization of the facility
boiler_upgrade.step2: Conducting engineering surveys to determine soil properties and foundation conditions to the extent necessary for retrofitting work, inspection and collection (obtaining) of industrial safety expert opinions on individual structural elements of the facility that are not affected by the modernization
boiler_upgrade.step3: Development of design documentation for technical retrofitting, which includes organizational and technical measures ensuring environmental and industrial safety.
boiler_upgrade.step4: Support and obtaining a positive expert opinion on the design documentation for technical retrofitting. Registration of the industrial safety expert opinion on the technical retrofitting project of the hazardous facility with the territorial authority of Rostekhnadzor
boiler_upgrade.step5: Execution of construction, installation, and commissioning works
boiler_upgrade.step6: Handover of the facility to the Federal Service for Environmental, Technological, and Nuclear Supervision
